about: the key view (CutSpec::key_view): key_end::counts_by per (row, key), and the voices and conclusion of x with the key view (view true) or without it (false), under the seat or the window rule

cases.name: a cosigned row: C, one cosigner, revoked itself after 2 (naming nothing); x signed at 3: C's voice drops, A B D E F stay (five of seven, the admission's count: x concludes)
the same with five signers (A B C D E): C's voice drops and x is four of seven: concludes nothing
a revocation that names x (C revoked after 9, x signed at 3, in its past): C's voice counts
a rotated key's late vote: D rotated to D2 at 1, the rotation naming D's record and not x: D's voice drops
an expired key's in-time vote: E's record ends at 4, x signed at 3 under it (no end row): E counts
the documented default, no key view (only for a caller with no key lane): C revoked late counts
and with no key view the rotated D counts
a cosign row by C naming x (C's own row, signed at 3), C revoked late: that voice drops
and the same cosign row with no key view: C's cosign counts
a revoked key's late window answer: h2 revoked itself (naming nothing) and its confirm c2 drops; the landing of 'confirmed' (h1 and h2, two of three) is h1 alone: concludes nothing
and with no key view (the documented default) the late confirm counts: the landing concludes
a rotated key's late ballot: E rotated to E2, the rotation not naming E's ballot: it drops, C and B tie two to two, and C's seating concludes nothing
and with no key view the ballot counts: C seated
K2e: a lift objection by a key revoked late: m2's revocation holds the room up to lm, not its objection o2: o2 drops, the re-seating rs concludes nothing and AG stays removed
K2f (control): m2's revocation holds o2: the re-seating concludes
and K2e with no key view: o2 counts, the re-seating concludes

K3c: a single key's receipt of a lone removal by a key revoked late: p2's revocation holds xm (its withdrawal of p1's moderate) and not its receipt r2: r2 drops, nothing keeps x in force once p1's moderate ends, AG is back
and K3c with no key view: r2 keeps x in force
K3e: a lone act by a revoked key: p1's revocation holds ag, not its lone removal x: x does not stand, AG stays
and K3e with no key view: x stands, AG removed
the thief's wipe naming nothing (C's stolen key revokes itself, holding no row): for a reader with no line, x concludes nothing
and for F, whose receipt took x up before it held the wipe: x concludes (settled on F's line)
and for G, which never took x up: x concludes nothing
and with x final by acknowledgement (three of seven receipts): x stands for everyone, a reader with no line too
an honest rotation from a device without the old rows (C to C2, naming only C's record): for a reader with no line, the in-time vote is cut (the caller duty: name the key's last rows)
and it holds for F, which took x up: x concludes
and with x final, it holds for everyone
the owner ends a stolen key after the thief voted on x (C's revocation holds C's record, not x): at F, which took x up first, the vote stands: x concludes
and at G, which held the end first (its receipt names the revocation and x), the vote is cut: x concludes nothing
and with x final (clean receipts by F, A and B; G's, holding the end, is not clean), it stands for both
a revocation by a rotated-away key is no end: C rotated to C2 holding x, then C's key (stolen) revokes itself after 0, the rotation in its past: x concludes

the person's self roster ends a retired key: P's roster (P1, P2 and C, the person's devices) removes C from 2 on by its own count (P1 and P2), holding C's rotation to C2 and x: x, signed at 3, is cut: concludes nothing
and a roster end the roster's count does not carry (C2, the successor, alone) is no end: x concludes

M1b: C revoked after 2 (holding C's record), then x signed with the stolen C at 3 holding the revocation, with receipts by F, G and the stolen C: C's own receipt is not clean, x is not final, and the late vote is cut: x concludes nothing

M1d: x signed with C at 3 concurrent with C's revocation (not holding it), receipted by F, G and the stolen C: C's own receipt is not clean (C's key is cut at it), two clean of three needed: not final, and the vote outside the revocation's past is cut: x concludes nothing
M1c: the same with receipts by F, G and A, each holding the revocation: none is clean, x is not final: concludes nothing
K1g: D rotated to D2 holding x, then whoever holds the retired D revokes it, naming nothing (the rotation not in its past): no end, x concludes

M2a EDGE (the stated residual, a person with one key): the thief rotates C (never rotated) to T, naming only C's record: an end of C like a revocation: the owner's vote x at 0 is cut for a reader with no line
M2b: the owner then revokes C holding x and the thief's rotation: no end (a rotation of C is held), and x stays cut by the thief's rotation
M2c: or the owner rotates C to C2 holding x: two rotations, a FORK of C: both are ends, x is outside the thief's: cut
and M2c for F, which took x up: x concludes (limb b protects it across the fork)
M3a: the owner rotates C to C2 at 4 holding the thief's x (at 3); P's roster ends C from 2 on by its count: x is cut
M3b: the thief also rotates old C to T (a fork): the roster end does not hang on a successor and still ends C: x is cut
M3c: the thief's rotation to T holds x: still a fork, and the roster end still ends C from 2 on: x is cut
M3d: T (the thief, no device of P's roster) alone signs a roster end of C from 0: the roster's count is not met, no end; the owner's x at 0, held by T's rotation, concludes
k3.py's K3c as written (p2's revocation holds nothing): for a reader with no line, xm (p2's withdrawal of p1's moderate) and r2 are both cut, and x stays in force: AG removed
and for p3, which cosigned xm (taken up): xm stands and r2 (not on p3's line) is cut: x falls out of force, AG is back

direct.name: a voice whose own end is in the final count's past never stands, x given as final
and one whose end is not in its past stands when x is final
